history.summary: CSV row 152 ('Durga Mandir') is a generic name shared by several shrines in Purnia; identified as the Maa Durga Mandir on Purnea-Siliguri Road, Bhatta Bazar/Khazanchi Hat, Purnia (Justdial, ~259 ratings; geocoder POI match). No documented history, founder or construction date was found; it is a modern locality shrine. Other Purnia shrines with the same generic name include Durga Mandir Court Station (Railway Station Road, Bhatta Bazar) and Kaptanpara Durga Mandir (Khuskibagh), so this identification is provisional. Not to be confused with the city's famous historic Durga shrine, the Puran Devi Mandir (Siddhapeeth Shakti shrine, said to be ~500 years old, abode of the ten Mahavidyas).

name: Maa Durga Mandir
town_description: Purnia (also Purnea) is a city in northeastern Bihar and the headquarters of Purnia district and division. An educational and commercial hub of the Seemanchal-Kosi region, it is nicknamed 'Mini Darjeeling' and takes its name from goddess Puran Devi (Puran Aranya).

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport: Bagdogra (IXB), about 160-170 km by road; Purnia's own airport is under development.
travel.railway: Purnea Junction, a major railhead on the Katihar-Samastipur section, lies within the city.
travel.road: NH 27 and NH 31 pass through Purnia; well connected by bus, auto-rickshaw and taxi.
